**Issue-closing convention set + 23 issues closed — auto-close never fires because slice PRs target feature/v2.0.0, not main**

**CONVENTION (owner, 2026-07-22): an issue closes when its work lands on `origin/feature/v2.0.0` — NOT when v2.0.0 reaches `main`.**

**ROOT CAUSE of the 39-open-issue backlog**: GitHub auto-closes an issue only when the linked PR merges into the **default branch** (`main`). Every slice PR in this repo targets `feature/v2.0.0` (correct — `.github/workflows/governance.yml` requires `Part of #N` for non-`main` bases and reserves `Closes|Fixes|Resolves` for base == `main`). So the closing keyword NEVER fires. Measured: `main` was **281 commits behind** `feature/v2.0.0`, and **26 of 39** open issues already had their work landed there. The open-issue count was a release-boundary artifact, not a backlog.

**CLOSED THIS SESSION (23)**: #297, #259 (D2/governance, after the fifth gate), #291, #293 (Track H cold-boot fixes), plus 19 audited: #193 #196 #201 #203 #205 #214 #219 #221 #226 #229 #231 #239 #244 #246 #249 #250 #253 #260 #264. Each closed with a per-issue evidence comment citing the specific verified clauses.

**METHOD THAT MATTERED — "commits citing #N" is NOT proof of completion.** Three parallel read-only subagents verified each issue's acceptance criteria **sub-clause by sub-clause** against `origin/feature/v2.0.0` (file existence, `git grep` for named symbols, named test presence). This caught real gaps a headline read would have missed.

**STILL OPEN — 4 needing the owner's judgement**:
- **#217** — substantive work complete in aggregate (#217+#219+#221+#223) but #217's OWN acceptance list was satisfied mostly by siblings; the split that happened is NOT the one pre-approved in its body (an ad-hoc re-split, self-attested in the checkpoint report).
- **#222 (CUTOVER)** — the real mutation happened and matched the dry-run forecast EXACTLY (275 records, 3 rejected, 4 empty, 0 unparseable), but the required "record the smoke-grep query + its answer" artifact is absent from the checkpoint report, PR #224, and the issue comments.
- **#247 + #256 (COUPLED)** — #247 migrated both named consumers and deleted `chunk-reader.mjs`, but its Acceptance says "`memory:share` no longer writes `.memory/chunks/`" and `share()` STILL materializes chunks; its own `design.md` descoped that item ("belongs to a separate change slice") — design contradicted acceptance and design won silently. Also no automated grep-guard test. #256's real bar (Half 2) is "#247 merged, done through Antigravity ALONE" — no baptism-completion artifact exists in-repo and git authorship cannot verify which harness was used.

**#266 (Track H) — ledger reconciled, NOT closed.** Two items need the owner: (1) `governance.reviewActors` is NOT populated in `brain.config.json` though `brain-writes-reviewed.mjs` reads it and `actor-check.test.mjs` fixtures it (REQ-266-6) — machinery exists, config doesn't; today's reviewer is a human account so the clause may be not-applicable. (2) The "no `size:exception`" criterion was violated twice, both human-granted and documented: #271 (402 counted, split blocked by the ADR+HOME co-promotion `decision-gate` requires) and #290 (the integration aggregate). Also H1-1's "TDD-RED reversion catches a deliberately vacuous test" clause was NOT verified and deliberately left unticked.

**12 open with no landed work found by the scan**: #280 #268 #267 #263 #210 #131 #130 #129 #124 #123 #117 #94. Plus #284 (reviewer v2 — active, and this session ADDED the `verdict: BLOCKED`/`blocked_by:` schema debt to it).

**CAVEAT recorded**: verification was by file/test presence, not by executing each issue's claimed green suite.</content>
